blocks.text: A newly observed certificate chain cannot be validated by the production trust store. Requests are being served by the last known-good endpoint while the security response workflow is active.

items.label: Impact
items.text: New connections are blocked; existing pooled connections continue until rotation.

blocks.title: Evidence retained
items: Full peer chain and TLS handshake metadata were written to the encrypted incident bundle.
No client secret, session token, or request body is included in the captured data.

blocks.title: Response sequence
items: Verify the certificate rotation record with the platform team.
Install a chain signed by an approved issuer and validate from an isolated probe.
Remove the fallback route only after two consecutive healthy checks.
